$comment: Contrast contract for the product surfaces (/app + /dashboard).
Pairs are declared by CSS CUSTOM PROPERTY NAME, not by literal colour. The gate
resolves each name against the real .theme-weeber / .theme-weeber.dark blocks in
packages/web/src/web/styles.css at run time, following var() indirection. That
means changing a token value in styles.css automatically re-measures here — the
contract cannot silently drift away from the stylesheet.
floor: 3   = large text, UI boundaries, icons, focus rings
A token used as an INPUT or CONTROL border must reach 3, even if it is also used
as a decorative divider elsewhere. That is the whole reason --border is split into
Marketing (.marketing scope) is deliberately NOT covered: it is out of scope for
the current implementation plan and would make this gate red for reasons nobody is
working on. Add its pairs when marketing comes into scope (Phase H).

pairs.label: primary button label on primary fill
sidebar active-pill text on pill fill

knownFailuresNote: The 9 pairs below fail TODAY. They are declared here so CI can fail on a NEW contrast regression without being red from the first commit — the same reason design-budget.json is a ratchet and not a lint rule. Phase B fixes them and deletes them from this list. Use `--strict` to ignore this list and see the real state; `--update` prunes entries that now pass. The ratchet only ever tightens: a known failure that gets WORSE fails the gate.

knownFailures.label: CONTROL BORDER (input) on page
knownFailures.why: --input: var(--border) — the audit's widest finding. Affects every field on ~40 pages.

knownFailures.label: CONTROL BORDER (input) on card
knownFailures.why: Same token, measured against the card surface it usually sits on.

knownFailures.label: CONTROL BORDER (input) on muted fill
knownFailures.why: Worst case in the repo. Disabled/readonly fields have no visible boundary at all.

knownFailures.label: status: warning text on page
knownFailures.why: --weeber-warning is tuned for a swatch, not for body text. Needs a darker text-role variant.

knownFailures.label: CONTROL BORDER (input) on page
knownFailures.why: Dark-mode --input, same root cause as light.

knownFailures.label: focus ring on card
knownFailures.why: NOT IN ui-audit.md — the audit only measured --ring against the page bg (3.32:1, pass). On card it is 2.85:1, so keyboard focus is sub-AA on every card-hosted control in dark mode. Found by this gate.

knownFailures.label: status: error text on card
knownFailures.why: --weeber-error as text on an elevated surface. Close, but under 4.5.
